package.name: ultrasound_probe_impedance
package.description: Drives the KUKA LWR Cartesian impedance controller from relative 6-DoF motions expressed in the ultrasound probe's own frame, converting them to absolute base-frame lwr_controllers/CartesianImpedancePoint commands using the fixed end-effector-to-probe calibration transform from ultrasound_probe_motion, and optionally closing a z-axis contact-force loop the same way ultrasound_trajectory's ee_incremental_impedance_node does.
